name: core.openwop.workflows.customer-onboarding
description: Customer-onboarding chains (RFC 0013): the post-sale first-mile — a warm welcome, a personalized kickoff checklist, and a scheduled 30-day health check. All external sends sit behind a human approval gate; tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic).
author: openwop

chains.label: New Customer → Welcome Email
chains.description: A new customer signs up (webhook) and gets a warm, personalized welcome email drafted from their signup details — reviewed by a human before it sends.

product.description: Product name referenced in the welcome copy.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

webhookPath.description: URL path segment this workflow listens on (e.g. `ci-failure`).

senderEmail.description: Verified sender address these emails are sent from.

recipientEmail.description: The address this email is sent to.

emailSubject.description: Subject line for the sent email.

config.systemPrompt: Write a warm, {{params.tone}} welcome email for a new customer of {{params.product}}. Reference their signup details, set expectations for the first week, and point to one clear next step. Under 150 words. No invented promises.

config.title: Review the welcome email before it sends

chains.label: Kickoff → Personalized Checklist
chains.description: Turns a new account's context into a tailored onboarding checklist and posts it to the team as an in-app notification so the CSM can act on it.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

triggerEventName.description: Host event name that starts this workflow (e.g. `crm.deal.won`).

config.systemPrompt: You are an onboarding specialist for {{params.product}}. From this account's context, produce a numbered kickoff checklist (5-8 concrete first-week tasks) tailored to their use case and segment. Each item is one actionable line.

chains.label: 30-Day Check-In (Scheduled)
chains.description: A scheduled check-in that drafts a personalized 30-day health-check email — reviewed by a human — asking how the rollout is going and offering help.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

scheduleCron.description: Cron expression for when this workflow runs (e.g. `0 9 * * 1` = Mondays 09:00).

senderEmail.description: Verified sender address these emails are sent from.

recipientEmail.description: The address this email is sent to.

emailSubject.description: Subject line for the sent email.

config.systemPrompt: Draft a brief, genuine 30-day check-in email for a customer of {{params.product}}. Ask how the rollout is going, invite one blocker to share, and offer a specific next resource. Warm, not salesy. Under 120 words.
